description: Use this when the user asks for current or licensed websites. To limit results to a Crew, set query.crewIds to its numeric Crew ID; use get_crew first when the user supplies a business name or email instead. Returns only data visible to the linked Market Brew account.

query.description: Optional filters: customerId, crewIds (comma-separated numeric Crew IDs), websiteId, serverHost, startDate, and endDate.

name: list_crew_websites
title: List licensed websites visible to the account
